name: SWEEP-FAST-part-off-by-one
new: seeds.filter((_, i) => i % k === p % k)
why: SWEEP-FAST: a part sweeps its neighbour's seeds - one part's twice, another's never

name: SWEEP-FAST-part-past-k
old: return k >= 1 && p >= 1 && p <= k ? { p, k } : null;
new: return k >= 1 && p >= 1 ? { p, k } : null;
why: SWEEP-FAST: a part past the parts taken - it sweeps nothing

name: SWEEP-FAST-part-zero
